IGUI_LWT_NotLayable: This part is not laid by hand.
IGUI_LWT_Blocked: No room for a pipe here.
IGUI_LWT_PortsFull: No free connection left on that part.
IGUI_LWT_NothingHere: There is nothing to dismantle here.
IGUI_LWT_NoSource: Must stand next to natural water (lake, pond, river) or a well.
IGUI_LWT_Pump_Standby: Pump: on standby, nothing needs water
IGUI_LWT_NoFilter: You need a water filter cartridge.
IGUI_LWT_NoFilterFitted: There is no filter in it.
IGUI_LWT_Filter_None: Filter: none, the water stays unfiltered
IGUI_LWT_NotNeeded: It does not need a repair.
IGUI_LWT_Outlet_idle: Water: the house tanks are full
IGUI_LWT_Outlet_unfiltered: Water: unfiltered, the house gets none (fit a filter)
IGUI_LWT_NotBarrel: There is no barrel here that can be connected.
IGUI_LWT_NoInlet: No house water inlet serves this place: set one against the outside wall of this building.
IGUI_LWT_Why_NotPlumbed: not plumbed yet: use a pipe wrench on it
IGUI_LWT_Why_NoInlet: no house water inlet serves it (too far, wrong floor, or none)
IGUI_LWT_Why_Other: its tank belongs to something else, and it is empty
IGUI_LWT_Why_Waiting: the water is on its way (within 10 minutes)
IGUI_LWT_Why_unfiltered: the pump's water is unfiltered: fit a filter
IGUI_LWT_Why_no_pressure: not enough pressure in the pipes
IGUI_LWT_Why_no_water: no water in the pipes (pump off, broken or without power)
IGUI_LWT_Why_gravity: the barrels stand lower than this fixture: a pump or power lifts the water
IGUI_LWT_Why_empty: the barrels are empty or hold something other than water
IGUI_LWT_Why_no_supply: the inlet has no pump and no barrel
